about: The Experience McAllen listing says the Rio Grande Valley Ballet has been part of the Valley holiday season for more than five decades, and this is the 54th anniversary production.
The orchestra is live for the 2026 run, conducted by Dr. Norman Gamboa, and the listing names Deborah Case as artistic director with guest artists Kirill Kruhlov and Emily Abrom.
The shows are listed under the McAllen Convention Center as organizer, in the Performing Arts Center at 801 Convention Center Boulevard. The venue phone on the listing is (956) 681-3800.
faq: Saturday, December 12 and Sunday, December 13, 2026, both at 3 PM.
McAllen Performing Arts Center, 801 Convention Center Boulevard, McAllen.
The host lists Ticketmaster and the McAllen Performing Arts Center box office. Ticket prices are not shown on the listing.
Yes, a live orchestra conducted by Dr. Norman Gamboa.
